course-recs.title: Course Recommendations
course-recs.description: Rubric-based teacher evaluation that generates on-demand AI course recommendations for scored growth areas. Domains carry rubric ratings feeding a gaps list, with recommendation cards to add to a cart, discard, or vary.

course-recs/single-page.html.title: Course Recommendations (Single Page)
course-recs/single-page.html.description: Single-page variant of the rubric teacher evaluation with AI course recommendations. Domains render as accordions on one scroll, with rubric ratings, a gaps-driven recommendation cart, and a submit gate.

course-recs/flat-form.html.title: Course Recommendations (Flat Form)
course-recs/flat-form.html.description: Flat-form variant rendering the evaluation as a linear list of questions. Offers varied field types, a configure-assignment modal, attachment options, and an apply-signature step, alongside course recommendations.

course-recs/evaluation-users.html.title: Evaluation Users (Redesign)

event-forms.title: Event Forms
event-forms.description: Request form for a restricted event, with event info, scheduling, custom questions and attachments. Drawers add sessions and permission rules, a role switcher flips author/approver views, and an add-presenter dialog.

manage-activities.title: Manage Activities

manage-events.description: Attendance roster for a multi-session event with expandable per-session sub-tables. An advanced-filters panel narrows by department, grade, and enrollment, with feedback-scope options and a release-credits action.
